articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Most Americans polled oppose betting on elections: Reuters
articles.description: The prediction market industry enables people to bet on US ‌elections and sporting events.

articles.title: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
articles.description: Cysic said the incident was limited to bridge message processing and minting and did not affect the mainnet or other operational systems.

articles.title: Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
articles.description: Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.

articles.title: Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
articles.description: The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.

articles.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
articles.description: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.

articles.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
articles.description: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.

articles.title: Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro under development
articles.description: “The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments,” according to the ECB president.

articles.title: Bitget to discontinue services for some users in one-off exercise
articles.description: Bitget says user funds are safe and exchange will continue to operate during the change.

articles.title: Crypto PACs escalate spending against Sherrod Brown in Ohio Senate race
articles.description: At least two industry-aligned PACs have poured more than $52 million into opposing Sherrod Brown’s return to the Senate.

articles.title: Stablecoin remittances cost 84% less than traditional transfers, report finds
articles.description: Borderless.xyz data shows major savings on cross-border business payments, with stablecoin transfers also settling faster than traditional international bank wires.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading
articles.description: Tokenized stocks are drawing trading activity beyond Wall Street hours, while Bitcoin miners confront costly AI expansion and new accounting rules could benefit stablecoins.

articles.title: Bitcoin price steadies around $82K after Fed’s Warsh avoids rate-hike hints
articles.description: Bitcoin held above $80,000 as South Korean tech stocks recovered from a sell-off and traders lowered their expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.

articles.title: Strategy conditionally declares daily dividends as STRC hovers below $100
articles.description: Strategy conditionally declared daily dividends on STRC, which continued to hover below its $100 par value.

articles.title: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
articles.description: Ledger was contacted about tampered hardware wallets risks months before its latest security crisis, with former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès questioning its response.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank prepares German crypto custody launch, eyes Asia: Report
articles.description: Germany’s largest bank reportedly plans to expand its digital asset custody services to Asian financial centers due to the growth of the digital asset economy.

articles.title: Solana’s Liu says Shanghai event postponed over registration surge
articles.description: Solana Foundation President Lily Liu said registrations quadrupled overnight, exceeding the attendance limit registered with local authorities.

articles.title: CONNECT recap: Liquidity is tokenization’s next challenge, everyday stablecoins
articles.description: Panelists at Cointelegraph’s Singapore CONNECT event explored opportunities in tokenized markets, the future of everyday stablecoin payments and the evolving landscape for crypto investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin may seek 20-month trend line reclaim before new record highs: CryptoQuant
articles.description: Bitcoin’s market cycle signals tool showed BTC price action copying history, possibly preparing to reclaim a key moving average before testing new highs.

articles.title: Capital B reports $78M H1 loss driven by Bitcoin impairment charge
articles.description: Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.

articles.title: Judge rejects CFTC, Gemini bid to undo $5M settlement
articles.description: Judge ruled changes in CFTC enforcement priorities and allegations of misconduct by its enforcement division were insufficient to overturn Gemini’s January 2025 settlement.

articles.title: OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
articles.description: An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary.

articles.title: Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans
articles.description: Network School founder Balaji Srinivasan wants to turn Farcaster into a haven for well-mannered techno-optimists. He had to do a bit of housekeeping first.

articles.title: MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy
articles.description: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi were previously identified for deletion under the methodology, with MSCI set to announce its final list on Nov. 11.

articles.title: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework
articles.description: Australia is among 77 jurisdictions committed to adopting CARF, with its first international exchanges of crypto tax data expected in 2028.

articles.title: Scammer loses $4.8M stored on tampered Ledgers: Asia Express
articles.description: A scammer reportedly lost $4.8M of stolen money after storing the funds on tampered Ledgers. Bitcoin and Ether ETFs launch trading in Thailand and South Korea blocks 27 exchanges.

articles.title: Binance.US seeks $1B valuation in potential $100M funding round: Report
articles.description: The crypto exchange was reportedly looking to use the additional funding to regain market share following Binance’s 2023 settlement with US authorities.

articles.title: Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
articles.description: The Wall Street Journal reported that a company co-founded by Bo Hines benefited from the passage of the GENIUS stablecoin bill.

articles.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
articles.description: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

articles.title: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments
articles.description: The launch of Global Money Platform marks Mastercard’s first major integration with BVNK since its August acquisition, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first companies to adopt the platform.
